title: ophrys argolica subsp. biscutella
intro: Ophrys argolica subsp. biscutella, commonly known as Bee Orchid, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the orchid family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys argolica subsp. biscutella include its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
